description: NR-003: Indian F-1 student (third calendar year), W-2 wages $20,000, $1,800 withheld. India has NO personal-services dollar exemption (treaty Article 21(1) covers only payments arising outside the U.S.), but Article 21(2) uniquely entitles an Indian student to the standard deduction — the Form 1040 single amount, $15,750 for TY2025. Taxable income $4,250; refund $1,372.
